summary.metric_note: Client TTFT is time to first nonempty visible-content chunk (includes network); E2E ends after stream validation. No per-token ITL is inferred from chunks. Output throughput uses successful requests only and includes failed-request time in the denominator.

limitations: GPU metrics describe device index 0; system metrics describe the whole host.
eBPF scheduling events are not connected in this milestone.
No automatic causal attribution or strategy performance claim is made.
KV ratios retain actual sampling intervals; they are not averaged into fixed buckets.
